newsitem.title: UK: UK merchant bank launches football investment fund.
newsitem.headline: UK merchant bank launches football investment fund.

text.p: Merchant bank Singer and Friedlander Group Plc said on Thursday it was launching a Football Fund to enable investors to buy into soccer clubs and related companies.

The fund -- to be set up next month -- plans to invest in soccer clubs in Britain and Europe as well as businesses such as media and clothing companies. It has signed up former Liverpool captain Alan Hansen to act as a consultant.
The minimum lump sum investment in the fund will be 1,000 stg and a regular monthly savings scheme will be available from 50 stg per month.

"With more and more clubs listing and attendance figures soaring, the Football Fund presents investors with an ideal opportunity to invest in the game and share in its fortunes," said Tony Fraher, chief executive of Singer & Friedlander Investment Funds.
"We expect the fund to be warmly welcomed by investors, fans and financial advisers," he added.
